protocol.target: same 12-DOF,20-cell variable-mass Kirchhoff ROM with ideal axial bias; excludes full-coil bias and fluid/contact
protocol.algorithms: Adam with same batches/update count; polynomial lr=.001, networks=.003 fixed after training/validation-only timing pilot. Validation selects frozen checkpoint every50 updates; test/OOD labels generated after all nine models frozen.
protocol.analytic_scope: complete degree3/4 momentum-quadratic mechanical residual,8749 parameters; no p^4; not exact full dictionary least-squares optimum

model_metadata.model: 3D inextensible unshearable Kirchhoff strain Ritz; exact SO(3) frame updates and midpoint centerline embedding
model_metadata.configuration: four Legendre curvature coefficients in each of two bending axes and torsion by default; all are dynamical
model_metadata.mass: configuration dependent; includes translational and rotary inertia from embedding Jacobians
model_metadata.KAM_status: Standard nonresonant elliptic KAM is not certified; circular isotropic rod with axial bias has paired bending frequencies.
model_metadata.relation_to_full_model: Shares material, distal magnet and field interface with the Cosserat model; shear/stretch omitted in this analytical ROM; modal truncation and fluid/contact closure errors are not yet bounded.
